newsitem.title: USA: USDA to amend plan for controlling poultry disease.
newsitem.headline: USDA to amend plan for controlling poultry disease.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Tuesday proposed amending the cooperative federal/state/industry arrangement for controlling certain poultry diseases to keep it up to date and provide for the use of new sampling and testing procedures.
In a notice in the Federal Register, USDA said the changes to the National Poultry Improvement Plan had already been okayed by plan participants. Public comments must be received by May 12.

Among the changes sought, USDA would estabish a "U.S. Salmonella Monitored" program for primary meat-type chicken breeding flocks and add a procedure for swabbing or collecting chick papers for bacteriological examination for salmonella.
